hero.description: From single-page landing pages to full-scale campaign sites, we design high-performance structures that maximize your ad budget and turn visitors into customers.

whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Don't Let Your Ad Budget Go to Waste
whatIs.paragraph1: Are you allocating budget to Google or social media ads but not getting the conversions you expect? The problem is usually not your ad campaign, but the page you are directing traffic to.
whatIs.paragraph2: A standard website distracts the visitor with dozens of menus and links. A campaign-specific landing page, on the other hand, focuses on a single goal: converting the visitor into a customer.
whatIs.paragraph3: As Sybor Digital, we design and develop data-driven, high-converting landing pages that perfectly align with your advertising strategy.

physical.title: Digital Advertisers
physical.description: I don't want my ad spend to go to waste; I want a dedicated page that will convert clicks directly into sales or leads.

startup.title: Those Launching New Products
startup.description: I want to build excitement for my new product, collect pre-registrations, and create an effective announcement page.

growing.title: Event & Webinar Organizers
growing.description: I need a page that persuades visitors and quickly collects registrations to increase attendance at my event.

global.title: Lead Generation Businesses
global.description: I want to capture qualified potential customers (leads) who fill out forms, request quotes, and contact us directly for my services.

whatWeDo.label: How We Help You
whatWeDo.title: We Put Conversion at the Center of Design
whatWeDo.paragraph1: We strategically structure every element on the page to serve a single purpose: the headline grabs attention, the content persuades, and the call to action (CTA) converts. We leave no detail to chance.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: We develop lightning-fast, mobile-first pages that work in perfect harmony with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and all other digital advertising platforms.
whatWeDo.paragraph3: Even after the page is live, we continuously increase your campaign performance with A/B testing, user behavior analysis, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

whyUs.label: Why Sybor Digital?
whyUs.title: The Right Partner for Performance Marketing
whyUs.subtitle: We design pages that don't just look good, but bring measurable profit.

reason1.title: We Know Conversion Psychology
reason1.description: Landing page design is an engineering of persuasion rather than aesthetics. We choose every color, button, and text based on data.

reason2.title: We Master the Ad Ecosystem
reason2.description: We code our pages to standards that will increase your Google Quality Score and lower your Cost Per Click (CPC).

reason3.title: Agile and Fast Delivery
reason3.description: In digital marketing, speed is money. We deliver projects rapidly without compromising quality so as not to disrupt your campaign calendars.

reason4.title: Holistic Approach
reason4.description: We manage design, development, copywriting, and analytics setup from a single source with perfect harmony.

reason5.title: Data-Driven Decisions
reason5.description: We optimize your page using real data like heatmaps and user session recordings, not assumptions.

reason6.title: Continuous Support
reason6.description: We are by your side even when your campaign is live; we quickly respond to your instant changes and optimization requests.

process.label: Process

discovery.title: Strategy & Goal Analysis
discovery.description: We analyze your advertising goals, target audience, and offer to build the persuasion architecture of the page.

design.title: Design & Copywriting
design.description: We write the sales copy that will prompt the visitor to take action and present the conversion-oriented interface design (UI/UX) for your approval.

development.title: Development & Integration
development.description: We turn the design into a lightning-fast page; we integrate CRM forms and analytics/pixel codes.

launch.title: Launch & A/B Testing
launch.description: We launch the page simultaneously with your campaign, monitor the data, and apply tests that will increase the conversion rate.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about landing pages and campaign sites.

delivery.question: How long does it take to complete a landing page project?
delivery.answer: Depending on the scope of the project and integration needs, we usually have it ready to launch within 1 to 2 weeks.

pricing.question: What does the pricing include?
pricing.answer: It includes custom design, fast web infrastructure, copywriting consultation, CRM form integrations, and basic pixel setups.

revisions.question: Can we make changes to the page while the campaign is running?
revisions.answer: Absolutely. Digital marketing is dynamic; we quickly implement your headline, image, and offer changes during the campaign.

maintenance.question: Do you set up A/B testing and heatmaps?
maintenance.answer: Yes. Based on your needs, we scientifically increase conversions by installing heatmaps (Hotjar, Clarity) and A/B testing tools on your page.

migration.question: Do you only do the design, or do you also write the copy?
migration.answer: The power of design comes from the copy. We edit your existing texts according to conversion-oriented (copywriting) principles or support rewriting them from scratch.

mobile.question: Can we publish it on a different domain than my current site?
mobile.answer: Yes, if you wish, we can publish it on a subdomain of your main domain (campaign.yourcompany.com) or on a completely independent new domain.
